primary_anchor_zh: 彼此分开的三只大型铜碗
story_reason_zh: 铜碗被取去清洗，随后放回料理台

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 一组大型铜碗在阳光厨房的宽料理台上，碗面反射稳定的窗光。
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 彼此分开的三只大型铜碗占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 厨师用宽托盘缓慢将三只铜碗一起搬出厨房门口；随后呈现空料理台和后方白色瓷砖。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 厨师用宽托盘缓慢将三只铜碗一起搬出厨房门口
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。
shot_design.remaining_visual_zh: 空料理台和后方白色瓷砖

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 厨师缓慢将装有三只铜碗的托盘搬回画面并放在料理台上
shot_design.main_action_zh: 厨师缓慢将装有三只铜碗的托盘搬回画面并放在料理台上
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 清楚呈现彼此分开的三只大型铜碗；不要求复现精确排列。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed wide shot frames three large copper bowls, clearly separated across the counter in a sunlit kitchen. Soft window light reflects across their broad surfaces.

A fixed wide shot shows three large copper bowls, clearly separated across the counter in a sunlit kitchen. A cook slowly carries a broad tray holding all three copper bowls through the kitchen doorway and out of frame. The fixed camera then holds on the empty counter and the white tiled wall behind it. A thin curtain near the window moves gently.
A fixed wide shot holds on the empty counter and the white tiled wall behind it. A cook slowly carries a broad tray with three large copper bowls back into frame and places it on the counter.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 厨师用宽托盘缓慢将三只铜碗一起搬出厨房门口
transition_design.shot_2_remaining_visual_zh: 空料理台和后方白色瓷砖
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 厨师缓慢将装有三只铜碗的托盘搬回画面并放在料理台上
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
